Class MazeEnginePlugin

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.plugin.PluginBase
org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
dev.despical.mazeengine.MazeEnginePlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.papermc.paper.plugin.lifecycle.event.LifecycleEventOwner, net.kyori.adventure.key.Namespaced, org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor, org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter, org.bukkit.command.TabExecutor, org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin
public final class MazeEnginePlugin extends org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
Coordinates the lifecycle of the MazeEngine plugin and its shared services.

Startup installs missing resources, validates configuration, loads saved maze state, and registers commands, listeners, visual sessions, and the Bukkit API provider. A startup failure disables the plugin rather than exposing services with incomplete configuration or missing saved records.

Reload builds a replacement Settings value before publishing it, so invalid configuration leaves the previous settings active. Shutdown unregisters the API and closes integrations, callbacks, displays, and maze workers in order. The service accessors are intended for enabled-plugin use on the server thread.

    • api

      public MazeEngineApi api()
      Returns the API provider owned by this plugin instance.

      Successful startup creates this provider and registers the same instance with Bukkit's ServicesManager under MazeEngineApi. Consumers may use this accessor when they already hold the plugin instance or resolve the registered service after enable.

      Registry access and operation submission follow the API's server-thread requirements. Disabling unregisters the service and closes its operation coordinator; retaining this reference does not extend the provider's usable lifetime. Before initialization, this accessor returns null.

      Returns:
      this plugin's API provider, or null before initialization
